title: New to the Path: What to Expect
intro_html: First time coming to Dhikr? Here's what to expect:
list_items: The evening usually runs around two hours
It opens with the Wadhifa, a set collection of dhikrs recited together. You don't need to know it by heart; just sit, listen, and join in as you're able
A short talk follows, then Maghrib prayer
The evening closes with refreshments and time to talk. This is as much a part of the gathering as the dhikr itself
Come as you are. No prior knowledge of Sufism or Arabic is expected
